title: autocompletion
name: Autocompletion — Tidwell
rule: As the user types a value with a known set of completions, suggest and complete matches.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Autocompletion (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Known completion set: suggestions appear from typed prefix and can complete the value.
fail_when: Known set is typed from memory with no suggestions.
overview: Suggest and complete matches from a known set as the user types.
apply_when: Fields with a known completion set and typed prefixes.
not_when: Open free-text with no known completion vocabulary.
agent_hint: Offer prefix suggestions from the known set and let them complete the value.
description: When the user types a value that has a known set of completions, the UI should suggest matches from the typed prefix and allow completing the value. Pass when suggestions appear and can finish the entry; fail when the known set must be typed entirely from memory with no suggestions. Use for closed or catalogued values, not open prose.
